document.title: Turn story replies into link clicks

use_when: A story reply containing the promised keyword should receive a replay or resource link directly.
avoid_when: Do not use a comment trigger or add a permission question when the reply already requests the link.
Do not silently drop an essential unsupported gate.
required_facts: Story/reply filters, destination link and non-click follow-up policy.
Confirm account scope, messaging permission and the real outcome measurement.

rules.failure_semantics: UI retry/expiry values are preserved per node. Transport/runtime failures were not tested; lack of runtime proof is not counted as an unopened setting.
